details: Research focus: optimising partial homomorphic encryption (Paillier) for privacy-preserving smart-home IoT networks.
Methods: cryptographic implementation in Python, a five-system virtual testbed, MQTT network experiments under controlled attacks, packet capture analysis and reproducible evaluation.
Dissertation: Detection of Phishing URLs Using Machine Learning. A practical Python project comparing eight classification algorithms, with a web interface for classifying URLs.
Practical digital forensics coursework using FTK Imager, Autopsy and EnCase.
Training in data science and security analysis.
Foundation in programming, computing systems and technical problem-solving.
